racialPassive.name: Regenerative Fleshmass
racialPassive.description: Consuming any kind of meat will heal wounds. 1 Meal = 1 Wound Slot.

racialAbility.name: Flesh Morphing
racialAbility.description: Can convert biomass into items and/or shapeshift, but only into biological things.

characterPassive.name: Biomass Engine
characterPassive.description: Every time you consume a corpse or a substantial amount of meat, gain 1 Biomass Stack (max 10). You can spend Biomass to: 1 Stack: +1 Muscle on a roll. 2 Stacks: Gestate Items. 3 Stacks: +3 hand to hand on a roll. 5 Stacks: Activate your Overdrive.

characterAbility.name: Apex Consumption (Overdrive)
characterAbility.description: Cost: 5 Biomass. For 3–5 turns: +3 Muscle, +2 Smarts, +4 on Restrain checks, regenerate 1 wound each turn, ignore movement penalties. When it ends: lose all Biomass, suffer -4 Muscle and -4 Agility for one turn from exhaustion.
